description:
Front Garden

T3	Holly (Ilex aquifolium)	Tree in neighbours garden - Cut back overhang by 1m to fence line. Final height 4m final spread 2m.

Rear Garden

T9	Yew (Taxus baccata)	Tree in no. 32. Trim overhang back to fence line. Final height 6m final spread 4m.
decision_conditions:
This decision does not give permission to enter neighbouring land or remove branches beyond the property boundary. In general, a landowner is entitled to prune branches which encroach onto their property, however any works should be limited to the minimum necessary to address the encroachment.

All pruning should be carried out in accordance with good arboricultural practice and care should be taken not to cause unnecessary damage to the tree. Excessive pruning or works extending beyond what is reasonably necessary to address the encroachment may give rise to liability for any resulting damage or loss.

Any arisings resulting from the pruning remain the property of the tree owner and should be offered back to them where appropriate.

The responsibility for ensuring that the proposed works are lawful and do not affect the long-term health or stability of the tree rests with the person carrying out the works.
